headlines.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
headlines.summary: Prolonged drought conditions affecting the Colorado River Basin led to record low hydropower generation this summer in the Southwestern electricity supply region, which includes Arizona, New Mexico, and small parts of Nevada and California.
